fusions.name: Barbed Cast
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed polyp at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Caught Fast
fusions.desc: A hooking strike that deals 8 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Spined Cover
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Barb Primed
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, your next ability deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
